shortDescription: Configuration for Certificate Revocation List resource.

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: basedn
options.description: Base distinguished name (DN), which is used in an LDAP search to search for a CRL. Citrix recommends searching for the Base DN instead of the Issuer Name from the CA certificate, because the Issuer Name field might not exactly match the LDAP directory structure's DN.

options.name: binary
options.description: Set the LDAP-based CRL retrieval mode to binary.

options.name: binddn
options.description: Bind distinguished name (DN) to be used to access the CRL object in the LDAP repository if access to the LDAP repository is restricted or anonymous access is not allowed.

options.name: cacert
options.description: CA certificate that has issued the CRL. Required if CRL Auto Refresh is selected. Install the CA certificate on the appliance before adding the CRL.

options.name: cacertfile
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the CA certificate file. /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path.

options.name: cakeyfile
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the CA key file. /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path

options.name: crlname
options.description: Name for the Certificate Revocation List (CRL). Must begin with an ASCII alphanumeric or underscore (_) character, and must contain only ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, hash (#), period (.), space, colon (:), at (@), equals (=), and hyphen (-) characters. Cannot be changed after the CRL is created.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my crl" or 'my crl').

options.name: crlpath
options.description: Path to the CRL file. /var/netscaler/ssl/ is the default path.

options.name: day
options.description: Day on which to refresh the CRL, or, if the Interval parameter is not set, the number of days after which to refresh the CRL. If Interval is set to MONTHLY, specify the date. If Interval is set to WEEKLY, specify the day of the week (for example, Sun=0 and Sat=6). This parameter is not applicable if the Interval is set to DAILY.

options.name: gencrl
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the CRL file to be generated. The list of certificates that have been revoked is obtained from the index file. /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path.

options.name: indexfile
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the file containing the serial numbers of all the certificates that are revoked. Revoked certificates are appended to the file. /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path

options.name: inform
options.description: Input format of the CRL file. The two formats supported on the appliance are: C(PEM) - Privacy Enhanced Mail. C(DER) - Distinguished Encoding Rule.

options.name: interval
options.description: CRL refresh interval. Use the C(NONE) setting to unset this parameter.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: method
options.description: Method for CRL refresh. If C(LDAP) is selected, specify the method, CA certificate, base DN, port, and C(LDAP) server name. If C(HTTP) is selected, specify the CA certificate, method, URL, and port. Cannot be changed after a CRL is added.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to access the CRL in the LDAP repository if access to the LDAP repository is restricted or anonymous access is not allowed.

options.name: port
options.description: Port for the LDAP server.

options.name: refresh
options.description: Set CRL auto refresh.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: revoke
options.description: Name of and, optionally, path to the certificate to be revoked. /nsconfig/ssl/ is the default path.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: scope
options.description: Extent of the search operation on the LDAP server. Available settings function as follows: C(One) - C(One) level below C(Base) DN. C(Base) - Exactly the same level as C(Base) DN.

options.name: server
options.description: IP address of the LDAP server from which to fetch the CRLs.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(created), the `create` operation will be applied on the resource. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: time
options.description: Time, in hours (1-24) and minutes (1-60), at which to refresh the CRL.

options.name: url
options.description: URL of the CRL distribution point.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
